title: Create Expanded
description: A Project Containes The Most Used "Create" Mods In Just A One Modpack. You Can Create Everything In Your Mind , Build Houses And Decorate it Easily
body:
Status Update on Create Expanded:

Development is active and focused on improving stability, performance, and overall gameplay balance. Updates may take time because the goal is quality over speed — testing machines, checking compatibility, and making sure everything works smoothly together.

If you are interested in contributing ideas, testing features, or helping improve the experience, you are always welcome. Feedback helps shape the future of the pack. Larger updates will focus on expanding automation possibilities while keeping performance stable for long-term worlds and multiplayer servers.

Create Expanded is a Vanilla+ styled modpack centered around mechanical engineering, automation, and immersive progression. The main focus is expanding the Create experience without turning the game into something completely different from Minecraft. The balance of survival remains important, progression feels natural, and the core of the game still feels familiar.

✨ Vanilla+ Philosophy

This pack is designed to feel like Minecraft — just expanded.

Create and its addons are the core of the experience. Outside of that, additions are carefully selected to improve quality of life, enhance building, and make exploration more interesting without overwhelming the player. The best gear progression remains close to vanilla standards, survival progression stays meaningful, and nothing feels overpowered or out of place.

The goal is simple:
Keep Minecraft feeling like Minecraft — but with gears, steam, trains, factories, and smarter systems.

⚙ Automation & Engineering

Create Expanded allows you to build:

Large-scale factories

Functional railway networks

Industrial processing systems

Automated farms and resource generation

Mechanical crafting systems

Moving contraptions and dynamic builds

Every machine is built using rotational power, making automation feel alive and mechanical instead of instant or magical.

⚡ Performance

Performance is a major priority.

The modpack includes carefully configured optimization mods to ensure:

Smooth FPS even with large contraptions

Better RAM usage

Faster world loading

Stable multiplayer performance

Playable experience on mid-range and laptop hardware

The aim is to push every frame and every tick out of your hardware while keeping the gameplay smooth and responsive.

Create Expanded is built for players who love engineering, creativity, and balanced progression — all inside a polished and optimized Vanilla+ experience.
